concerns.text: Violation of Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene). T001 mentions validating 'provenance' but fails to include the mandatory requirement to generate checksums and record them in the project state YAML.

Violation of Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy). T006 refers to 'verified GWAS catalogs' but does not explicitly task the use of the Reference-Validator Agent to perform this verification, which is a non-negotiable gate.

Dropped acceptance criteria. T002 verification relies on `dataset.schema.yaml`, but the schema only defines types. It fails to verify SC-001 (≥ 80% cell retention) and SC-002 (≥ 20% variance increase), which are specific measurable outcomes in the spec.
